title: Chrono24 Listing Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chrono24:listing
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(brand) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Chrono24 listing events land each day and how many distinct brand values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Chrono24 listing records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct brand values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much Chrono24 listing activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
